desc: Read N and the list P[1..N] using fast input (`sys.stdin.buffer.read`).
Implement a Fenwick tree class with `add`, `sum`, and `find_kth` methods.
Initialize a Fenwick tree of size N with all ones (all positions initially free).
For i from N down to 1:
Use `find_kth(P_i)` to obtain the index `pos` (1-indexed) of the P_i-th free slot.
Update Fenwick at `pos` with -1 to mark it occupied.
Output the final array `ans` as space-separated integers.
Test the program on the two sample inputs to ensure correct output.
